aboutPage.title: About the forum
aboutPage.subtitle: Leadership for Generations
aboutPage.photoCaption: Aidar Kazybayev — initiator of the ESG Leadership Forum, founder of Global ESG Partnership and ESG Management School, author of the EMBA programme “ESG and Sustainable Development”
aboutPage.p1: I invite you to ESG Leadership Forum Astana 2027 — a forum we designed as a place for people who connect sustainable development with investment, management and business growth. The theme is “Leadership for Generations”. It is not a slogan. It is a commitment: the decisions we take today decide the country and the planet our children will live in.
aboutPage.p2: In recent years ESG in Kazakhstan and Central Asia has moved from a fashionable term to a working tool. Banks issue green bonds, companies publish non-financial reports, the state is building a carbon-regulation system, and universities are opening sustainability programmes. I have seen this path from the inside — creating the National ESG Club, developing green finance at the AIFC, and training managers at ESG Management School and on the EMBA. What is missing is not ideas, but a place where ideas become agreements and projects.
aboutPage.p3: That is why the forum is built around decisions, not speeches. Five tracks — Lead, Finance, Planet, People, Region — cover corporate governance and ESG ratings, sustainable finance and carbon markets, the energy transition and the circular economy, human capital and business partnerships with NGOs, and joint projects of Central Asia and partner countries. Each track ends not with a resolution, but with commitments we will check a year later.
aboutPage.p4: The forum brings together four formats: a business programme with company leaders, investors and representatives of public and international organisations; ESG Expo, where technology meets buyers; the independent ESG Award with 14 nominations and a grand prix; and a youth programme — 100 delegates and the Youth Impact Pitch final. Leadership for generations means young leaders sit in the same room as the people who decide today.
aboutPage.p5: On 13–14 October 2027 we expect 500 participants from more than 20 countries in Astana. Come with a case, a question or a project — and leave with partners.

aboutPage.orgText: Global ESG Partnership is the single organiser of the forum. It brings the business programme, the exhibition, the independent award and youth initiatives around the shared theme “Leadership for Generations”. Partners choose a substantive role; the organiser records the scope of participation and the commitments in an agreement and, after the forum, provides a report on the agreed indicators.
aboutPage.personText: Aidar Kazybayev is the initiator of the forum, founder and CEO of Global ESG Partnership, founder of ESG Management School and author of the EMBA programme “ESG and Sustainable Development”. He was previously CEO of the AIFC Green Finance Centre and chair of the National ESG Club. He is managing partner of the National Academy of Corporate Governance.
aboutPage.schoolText: ESG Management School is an international school of ESG management. Together with L. N. Gumilyov Eurasian National University it delivers the EMBA “ESG and Sustainable Development” — the first programme of this format in Kazakhstan for leaders and sustainability specialists.
